name: Martian Crypto Bro #3
description:
This collection is inspired by the “Face of Mars”: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cydonia_(Mars) 

The Face of Mars refers to a humanoid-like picture taken by Mars orbiters Viking 1 and Viking 2. It is a play of light and shadow. Nonetheless, this image captured my imagination and served as an inspiration for my very first collection supported by my original electronic music.

This collection is a homage to human aspirations to colonize and ultimately terraform planet Mars.
